Results.ReviewText:
I’m very pleased with my new Spirit e325 NG.   The barbecue is meeting all of my expectations, perhaps a little more. My only complaint is that perhaps I did not look at the obvious labels on the front of the BBQ. After ignition the knob points to high and to turn flame down, turn it all the way, unless you turn to “ boost.”
Everything is that I was able to set the dials a little under halfway and it maintained a very steady 350-375°
I would definitely recommend this barbecue
Results.Title: Even easier than my old WEBER

Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased this BBQ and I love it. It has performed beyond my expectations.
Results.Title: Great BBQ

Results.ReviewText: I’m generally very pleased with the grill.  So far, my favorite thing about it is that it holds constant temperature very well.  One star off for not having four casters—it makes moving it a PITA.
Results.Title: Generally a vey nice grill

Results.ReviewText: Instructions are too small (needd a magnifying glasss to read)….too wordy. Appears that you paid the writer by the letter
Results.Title: GET OUT YOUR MAGNIFYING GLASS

Results.ReviewText: This grill is perfect. Cooks well, best steaks I've made. The sear zone is great. Just the right amount of char on roasted peppers. Love it.
Results.Title: All I need

Results.ReviewText: Replaced same model I’d had for 12 years that was still working fine but bottom was rusting out. A couple of small improvements works fine and a reasonable price.
Results.Title: Best bang for buck

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill but for one thing. They only have two wheels on this model and I would like four wheels. It is very difficult to move around and put away when finished. My previous spirit had four wheels and it was never an issue in storing.
Results.Title: Wish it had wheels

Results.ReviewText:
Nice unit.  Easily started, thermometer was easy to read, heat seemed uniform.  The side shelves easily lowered to improve sightlines from our adjacent screened porch.  The only downside: it was not easy to connect to our existing gas line. Customer service used FaceTime to tell
Me that an attempt to connect had damaged an end. I was emailed a graphic that better than the manual showed the parts needed to make the connection, but those were not supplied by nor could they be ordered from Weber. I ended up hiring a guy for $90 from. Fireplace shop who came out and quickly installed it. I used it tonight for the first time.  Easy, success.
Results.Title: I like it. Even though the manual was inadequate

Results.ReviewText: After having been a charcoal grill user for many years, I cannot say enough about the convenience of using this LP gas grill.  So efficient and quick that it makes up for the lack of smoking the meal (although there are ways to also get the smoke).  I am glad that I made the switch!
Results.Title: Very pleased with our new Weber LP gas grill!

Results.ReviewText: My old grill finally gave up the ghost.  It had become too large now that my wife and I are the only ones left at home. The Websr's three burners fit our needs perfectly now. The boosted burners are and added plus that i really like. The Weber grill is easiier to use and clean than my old old grill.
Results.Title: Great small griil

Results.ReviewText:
First Weber grill I have owned.  Had a high end grill for twenty years replacing the entire insides several times, but finally gave out and parts no longer readily available. 

While the 325 is not the largest, it is a true Weber grill providing the functionally of larger series.  The three burners provide all the heat needed, plenty of grilling space, searing with two burners and facilitates indirect heat for excellent cooking results. I have yet to find any cool spots which provides for even, consistent results. Love the grill and anticipate this will be the last grill I need.
Results.Title: True Weber

Results.ReviewText: The grill works great - though after only about 5 uses it wouldn't light. The folks at Weber support were extremely helpful with troubleshooting and it turned out the regulator was faulty and they shipped me a new one quickly and now it's working fine. Disappointing that that happened, but I love the grill. The size is just right and it's easy to operate.
Results.Title: Wonderful grill after faulty regulator replaced

Results.ReviewText: I've only fired this thing up a few times, but so far I'm surprisingly unimpressed considering this is a Weber. I'd expected much, much more. It looks nice. Not a lot of fun putting it together. But that was to be expected. But the thing just doesn't seem to cook really hot even with the recommended preheating for 15minutes. I hope it's user error, but so far I've got a bit of buyer's remorse.
Results.Title: I expect more from Weber

Results.ReviewText: I have owned Weber grills for over 25 years and have been very happy with them.  In February I bought a Weber E 325.  The grill looks good and is the right size.  The problem is in the size of the flame and the starter.  You cannot see if the flame is lit so you do not know if the starter worked.  In addition, when starting you must only turn the knob exactly to the point of the click.  I will not buy this model again
Results.Title: Not what I expected
